questions.q: The derivative of y = sin³x with respect to x is —
If y = sin 2x cos 3x, then dy/dx is —
If y = cot x°, then dy/dx is —
If y = (1/a) cot⁻¹(x/a), then dy/dx is —
If y = sin⁻¹(cos x), then dy/dx is —
questions.work: sin⁻¹(cos x) = sin⁻¹(sin(π/2 − x)) = π/2 − x (0 ≤ x ≤ π) ⇒ dy/dx = −1.

sections.title: Objective type questions of two 1-mark parts.

questions.q: Fill in the blanks: (a) If y = √(sin³x), then dy/dx = ______. (b) If y = sin⁻¹(x²), then dy/dx = ______.
If cos y = x cos(a + y), prove that dy/dx = cos²(a + y)/sin a.
questions.answer:
x = cos y/cos(a + y). dx/dy = [−sin y cos(a + y) + cos y sin(a + y)]/cos²(a + y) = sin(a + y − y)/cos²(a + y) = sin a/cos²(a + y).
So dy/dx = cos²(a + y)/sin a.

questions.q: Differentiate x sin x + cos x with respect to x.
questions.answer: (1·sin x + x cos x) − sin x = x cos x.

questions.q: If y = sin⁻¹x, show that (1 − x²) d²y/dx² − x dy/dx = 0.
questions.answer:
dy/dx = 1/√(1 − x²) ⇒ √(1 − x²) y' = 1.
Differentiate: √(1 − x²) y'' + y'(−x/√(1 − x²)) = 0.
Multiply by √(1 − x²): (1 − x²)y'' − xy' = 0.
